name: Misha
summary: Beside Rexxar, Misha roams Kalimdor as his loyal bear companion. Rexxar is the half-ogre beastmaster and Champion of the Horde, and she stays close as he travels.

sections.title: A Boundless Bond
sections.body: Misha walks beside Rexxar, a solitary half-ogre who trusts beasts more than people. The brown bear and the wandering beastmaster have forged a fierce, protective bond through many wildernesses and bloody battles.

sections.title: Defender of Durotar
sections.body: Misha is a seasoned warrior, not merely a tame pet. She fought beside Rexxar against Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore Isle, helping secure the young Horde's survival. Away from battle, her keen senses and strength extend Rexxar's will.

sections.title: Wilds of Kalimdor
sections.body: Travelers on the long tracks through the Stonetalon Mountains, Desolace, and Feralas may find Misha padding beside Rexxar. She is fierce enough to tear apart any predator that threatens them. In an untrustworthy world, she remains Rexxar's steadfast anchor.

aliases: who is the bear with rexxar
faq.answer: Misha is Rexxar's lifelong companion, a ferocious brown bear who wanders the wilds beside the Champion of the Horde. They travel together across central Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where can Misha be found right now?
faq.answer: Misha walks beside Rexxar on the long tracks through the Stonetalon Mountains, Desolace, and Feralas.

faq.q: Did Misha take part in the founding of Durotar?
faq.answer: Yes. After the Third War, Misha joined Rexxar in battle against Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's forces at Theramore Isle to defend the fledgling Horde.

faq.q: Is Misha hostile to Alliance players?
faq.answer: Yes. Misha is the companion of the Champion of the Horde, and she fiercely defends Rexxar by attacking Alliance trespassers who draw too close.

faq.q: Why does Rexxar prefer beasts like Misha to people?
faq.answer: Disillusioned by the deceit and warfare of humanoid races, Rexxar chose solitude in the wilderness. He believes beasts are direct and honest, and finds in Misha a companion free of betrayal.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can look to Misha as an ideal animal companion. Their lifelong partnership rests on mutual respect, not mere dominance.
As a member of the Horde, you can remember Misha's fight beside Rexxar to secure the fledgling Horde's freedom at Theramore Isle. Veterans across Durotar quietly respect her.
